note: Local government Proposition 123 affordable housing commitments, joined from DOLA's own lists: first-cycle (2024-2026) commitment filings, verified expedited review ("fast track") policies, jurisdictions verified as meeting every statutory requirement, and second-cycle (2027-2029) commitments filed so far in 2026. Built by scripts/policy/build_prop123_jurisdictions.py. HB26-1313 (signed and effective 2026-05-26 under its safety clause) replaces the 3% annual-growth eligibility requirement with permit-and-job-growth targets beginning the 3-year cycle on 2027-01-01; the required_commitment values below describe the current cycle.
